title: Flight Test Results for the Daedalus and Light Eagle Human Powered Aircraft
date_qualification: The metadata and printed cover dates differ; neither establishes the later ASWING Bode run date or operating point.
source_role: Primary flight-research report cited by Drela's 1989 wing-load paper. Light Eagle structural dynamics and Daedalus performance are distinct subjects.
qualifications: Light Eagle dynamics are supporting physical evidence, not matched Daedalus or native ASWING reference results.
Table 3-2 describes free-free structural frequencies with apparent mass at zero flight speed, not damped full-aircraft poles at 6.7 m/s.
Table 2-3's printed imperial and SI inertia rows differ by approximately a factor of ten after unit conversion. Preserve both; do not substitute either aircraft's inertia into the public dae.asw.
Section 3.2 uses phenomenological lag estimates. They are not evidence for replacing the documented ASWING unsteady law or fitting a lag coefficient.
The original eight-source authoritative catalog remains unchanged.
